night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.name: Hunter in the Night
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.description: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.scepter_description: Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.shard_description: Hunter in the Night may be cast on a creep, instantly killing it and restoring some of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana. Cannot target ancients during the daytime.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.facet_night_stalker_dayswap: Increases the max level of Hunter in the Night to %max_level_tooltip%. Night Stalker starts with a bonus level of Hunter in the Night.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.lore: The hunting prowess of Balanar improves as the night beckons.

night_stalker_void.name: Void
night_stalker_void.description: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
night_stalker_void.shard_description: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.
night_stalker_void.facet_night_stalker_blinding_void: Enemies affected by Void do not share vision with their allies. Affected enemies take damage per second when they are not visible to their allies.
night_stalker_void.facet_night_stalker_voidbringer: Increases the max level of Void. Level %max_level% Void at night becomes ground targeted, increases movement and attack slow, and applies to a %cast_radius_tooltip% AoE.
night_stalker_void.invisible_damage_pers: DAMAGE PER SECOND WHEN NOT VISIBLE:
night_stalker_void.lore: Balanar creates a vortex of infinite night, tearing opponents violently into the eternal darkness that once was.
night_stalker_void.note0: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.

night_stalker_crippling_fear.name: Crippling Fear
night_stalker_crippling_fear.description: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.
night_stalker_crippling_fear.lore: A vision of the twisted maw of Balanar etches itself into the minds of the poor souls unlucky enough to cross his path.

night_stalker_darkness.name: Dark Ascension
night_stalker_darkness.description: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.
night_stalker_darkness.lore: It is a humbling sight to see when the mightiest of warriors become afraid of the dark.
